title: Château d'Amboise
scope: The surviving royal lodging ranges, Chapelle Saint-Hubert, Minimes, Heurtault and Garçonnet towers, and the connecting limestone terrace walls.
limitations: Roof and chapel heights use the scale of the documented surviving wings. Terrace masonry, fine sculpture and less visible roof details are simplified. The original DEM preserves the bluff and terrace but averages narrow vertical edges.
